all_direct_document_groups.conservative_rule: Count first-design groups and pre-seal supplier groups only where at least one directly read source row has an explicit true original eligibility flag, then union the thirteen separately identified post-seal sources by duplicate_group. This gives 12 first designs + 41 eligible pre-seal supplier groups + 5 cross-field groups + 1 new supplementary group = 59. Seven supplementary rereads add zero.
all_direct_document_groups.preferred_label: 49 qualified document groups: 12 first-design, 32 actually A/B-cited supplier, and 5 cross-field groups.
all_direct_document_groups.broader_report_label: 59 conservatively eligible document groups across original reading and separately identified post-seal work; provenance-ledger count, not independently revalidated bodies.

per_question_AB_membership.discrepancy: Q09 is stored as 2 but has 3 eligible A/B-cited groups. The NumPy C-array API group D-ba20166dd6d1513fd060 is cited for both Q09 and Q12; its one global counted representative is assigned to Q12. The global 32 remains correct.
per_question_AB_membership.rule: Per-question coverage must count qualifying membership in that question, then deduplicate across questions for the global total; alternatively relabel current numbers as globally allocated representative-group counts.

recommendations: Keep 12/32/5 and the qualified union 49 as the primary source-minimum figures.
Do not describe the raw 64 as independently validated substantive direct originals. If a broader inventory is required, disclose the conservative 59 rule and keep post-seal sources separate.
Clarify cross-field question-link namespaces and fix or relabel the Q09 per-question coverage statistic.
Preserve original ledgers and sealed initial judgments; apply any report/count correction separately with this audit as provenance.
limits: No new web/source-body research was performed. Direct-read assertions for the whole inventory were checked as recorded provenance rather than every raw response being reread.
The four initial Go designs retain their disclosed GHArchive capture basis; this audit does not convert them into official-hosted immutable sources.

Distinct catalog, individual item, and drawing pages are separate document groups; their relation to one object/product does not make them mirrors, and their factual discrepancies are not resolved by counting.
Current/development editions are collapsed only for conservative document counting, not to combine their behavioral evidence.
No source-minimum count implies predicate support, original author ignorance, historical availability, or saved implementation effort.
